name: platformize-bin-ios
title_zh: 一条命令把 C/Rust 工具搬进越狱 iOS 双生
tagline_zh: 不用碰 Xcode 工程，不用懂签名。CMake 或 Cargo 项目自动产出 roothide 与 rootle…
tagline_en: Skip Xcode and signing. Auto-build CMake/Cargo projects into roothide + rootless packages, release via Actions.
desc_en: Port an upstream command-line tool (C/CMake, Rust/Cargo, …) to jailbroken iOS and ship it as a packaging-only repo that builds one arm64 binary and packages it for both roothide (iphoneos-arm64e) and rootless (iphoneos-arm64) bootstraps, releases via GitHub Actions, and is picked up by the OwnGoalPackages APT repo. Use when asked to "build X for jailbroken iOS", "package X like codex/grok/fastfetc
why_zh: 把上游构建系统当黑盒，只接管打包层。同一份源码产出 arm64e 与 arm64 两套 deb。
why_en: Treats upstream build as a black box, owns only packaging. One source yields arm64e + arm64 debs, auto-indexed by APT repo—no.
limit_zh: 只认 C/CMake 与 Rust/Cargo 两种上游；不处理 GUI 应用、不处理动态库依赖。
limit_en: Only C/CMake and Rust/Cargo upstreams. No GUI apps, dylib deps, or tweaks. Output ends at .deb—no post-install testing.
title_en: Port C/Rust CLI tools to jailbroken iOS dual-bootstrap
